fact: UNICEF summative evaluation (October 2024) says Mozambique introduced e-SIRCEV and the NUIC, but the NUIC link across life events still needs historical manual data migrated into e-CRVS, about 20% of provinces lack e-CRVS and e-CRVS is not fully integrated with health systems.
title: Avaliação sumativa do programa de Reforço do Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais (CRVS) em Moçambique
